params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Sparse fieldset — comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

params.name: media_type
params.description: Limit result set to attachments of a particular media type.

params.name: mime_type
params.description: Limit result set to attachments of a particular MIME type.

items.docs: Lists media library attachments. `X-WP-Total` reports 161, but an anonymous caller receives a single attachment (id 1503); the rest are attached to non-public parents and are filtered out of the anonymous view.
